description: Build an unsigned transaction to withdraw assets from an Arcadia account to the owner's wallet. Only the account owner can withdraw. Will revert if the account has debt and withdrawal would make it undercollateralized. Does not support max_uint256 — pass exact amounts from read.account.info. Account version is auto-detected on-chain (override with account_version if needed).

account_version.description: Override account version (3 or 4). Auto-detected on-chain if omitted.

asset_amounts.description: Amounts in raw units/wei, one per asset

asset_ids.description: Token IDs: 0 for ERC20, NFT token ID for ERC721

asset_types.description: V4 only. Asset types per asset: 1=ERC20, 2=ERC721, 3=ERC1155. If omitted, inferred from asset_ids (non-zero → ERC721).

name: write.account.withdraw
